text.text_excerpt: I'm that girl that's all about pinching heads & sucking tails... All things CRAWFISH!!!! And Michael's fits the bill. The price is right. The taste is GREAT. The location is good. Friendly staff. And they ANSWER THE PHONE when you call. Winnnnning!!!!! Initially, I stopped in for shrimp some time ago, but then as of late, I've returned for Crawfish & I've not been disappointed yet. 10lbs or more and you have a discounted price on the mud bugs. I noticed other items in the freezer & I've stored this in the recesses of my mind, but my recent visits have been ALL about the CRAWFISH. This is one of my "go to" places for Crawfish & I couldn't be happier. Don't be surprised if you see me here w...

This is my 3rd time here, and man I'm telling you these folks have some of the best tasting Crawfish in this city. I should also mention they are cheaper by as much as a dollar a pound. Crawfish are plentiful right now and most places are charging over $4.00 a pound. That is Highway robbery for Crawfish. There in one place on Chef Hwy. charging over $5.00 a pound. That is absolutly crazy. But I digress, Michael's is the real deal. If I'm willing to drive from the other side of town 10 pounds minimum is in order. When I got them home they went like wild fire. I was left wondering why I didn't get more. $3.24 was the price today which is reasonable compared to the others. Top of my list now.

If you are looking for well seasoned, juicy, boiled seafood at an extremely competitive price, Michael's is that place you have been looking for. They had a very well seasoned taste but weren't overly spiced. Probably my only complaints would be all the lemon slices mixed with the crawfish to make the crawfish weigh more on the scale. It would be fine if it was like 1-2 slices but it was like 10 thick slices mixed in 4 pounds of crawfish. My only other disappointment was that they were sold out for the day at 4pm. I may have gotten that many lemons only because it was the bottom of the pot but not sure. I'll certainly be back, especially because the quality and price are a good combo!
